steps: Add chicken thighs to a bowl and sprinkle with salt and white pepper.
Leave to marinate for about 10 minutes
Rince rice with colder water and drain.
Heat oil in a pot over medium heat, then add green onions, ginger and garlic - fry until fragrant then remove ⅔ and set aside.
Put in rice and fry for 30 seconds.
Add 2 cups water and ¼ teaspoon of salt, then use spatulata to scrape the bottom to loosen up crisp rice.
Place the marinated chicken on top without overlapping.
Leave to cook uncovered until water starts to boil gently.
Put a lid on and turn heat to lowest - cook for 20 minutes.
Turn off heat when time is up and let sit for a further 10 minutes.
Take out chicken thighs, remove bones and slice.
Put rice in individual plates with chicken and (optionally) cucumber on the side.
Add soy sauce, lime juice and sesame oil to fried aromatics to serve as a dipping sauce.

notes: Remember not to open lid during cooking process!

recipe_info.title: One-pot Hainanese Chicken Rice
recipe_info.intro: An easy version of the classic Hainanese chicken rice, this one-pot recipe is very simple to make.
